```{css, echo=FALSE}
th {
  white-space: nowrap;

```

Two versions of the SQLite database are published as assets on the same [GitHub release](https://github.com/seafood-hazards/mudab-pilot/releases/tag/v0.1.4): the full Mudab schema used by this site, and the slim, multi-source-friendly schema.

## Available Databases

```{r}
library(tibble)

database_tbl <- tribble(
  ~Version, ~File,                     ~Schema,                                     ~Download,
  "Full",   "pilot_mudab.sqlite",  "[DB Schema (Full)](./db-schema.qmd)",       "[Download](https://github.com/seafood-hazards/mudab-pilot/releases/download/v0.1.4/pilot_mudab.sqlite)",
  "Slim",   "mudab_slim.sqlite",   "[DB Schema (Slim)](./db-schema-slim.qmd)",  "[Download](https://github.com/seafood-hazards/mudab-pilot/releases/download/v0.1.4/mudab_slim.sqlite)"
)

knitr::kable(database_tbl)
```
